purpose: Retain an exact completed stage product before any downstream admission decision so a refused, interrupted, or resumed newsroom circuit never purchases the same work twice.
preconditions: The customer supplies a named stage, the provider contract, a mechanism digest, and the semantic digest of every input that can change the product.
The hired witness-journal RDF provider is available to encode the product as a typed deterministic-CBOR object and witness its append-only admission.
postconditions: At most one product identity is admitted for an exact stage-request digest.
The complete product needed by the next stage is retained, not merely its provider receipt.
A repeated exact request returns the retained product without invoking the producer.
refusals: A request digest has conflicting admitted product identities.
A retained product fails its caller-supplied shape admission.
The product cannot be witnessed through Koios's contracted witness-journal RDF provider.
serialization: Koios code shapes the relational value; inference providers produce prose or choose tools and never serialize this record.
